intro.en: Your logo, 1C, as the loading screen: it arrives, then opens onto the site (your Aoraki photograph stands in for the home page). Click anywhere or press R to play it again. On a page, , and . move to the previous or next version, 1 to 5 scores it, N opens your notes, M marks a spot, B comes back here. To see several together, press Compare side by side and tap their pictures.
intro.zh: 你選的標誌 1C 當載入畫面：它出現，接著打開進到網站（用你的 Aoraki 照片代表首頁）。點畫面任何地方或按 R 再看一次。在頁面上，逗號和句號鍵（, .）換上一版或下一版，1 到 5 打分數，N 打開筆記，M 標記一個地方，B 回到這裡。想一起看幾版：按「並排比較」，再點它們的縮圖。

title.en: Second round: the line keeps loading, the rest changes
title.zh: 第二輪：線照樣跑，其他地方換

title.en: Third round: the line, TUAN first, then four ways to open
title.zh: 第三輪：先跑線、TUAN 先出來，四種打開的方式

desc.en: As on the font pages: the letters rise one by one, the line draws across, PHOTOGRAPHY fades in. Then the paper fades to the photograph.
desc.zh: 跟選字體時一樣：字母一個一個浮上來，線畫過去，PHOTOGRAPHY 淡入。接著紙淡掉，露出照片。

desc.en: The line opens from the middle; TUAN rises out of it and PHOTOGRAPHY drops out of it. Leaving, both sink back into the line and it closes.
desc.zh: 線從中間打開，TUAN 從線往上長出來，PHOTOGRAPHY 從線往下出來。離開時兩個都縮回線裡，線再收起來。

desc.en: The logo comes up slowly, like a print in the developing tray; then the photograph develops in from pale grey to full colour.
desc.zh: 標誌像暗房裡的相紙一樣慢慢顯出來；接著照片從淡淡的灰慢慢顯影成彩色。

desc.en: The letters drift in from far apart to their places, then the line draws out from the middle.
desc.zh: 字母從很開的地方慢慢靠攏到位置，線再從中間往兩邊畫開。

desc.en: It arrives letter by letter, a little quicker; then the paper parts along the line, TUAN going up and PHOTOGRAPHY down, and the photograph is there between them.
desc.zh: 字母一個一個出來，稍微快一點；接著紙沿著那條線分開，TUAN 往上、PHOTOGRAPHY 往下，照片就在中間出現。

desc.en: TUAN and PHOTOGRAPHY are there at once; the line fills from left to right as the photograph really loads, then it opens.
desc.zh: TUAN 和 PHOTOGRAPHY 一起出現；線從左到右填滿，就是照片真的在載入，滿了才打開。

desc.en: Only the line, on bare paper. Once it is full, TUAN rises letter by letter and PHOTOGRAPHY follows, then it opens.
desc.zh: 紙上先只有那條線在跑。跑滿了，TUAN 一個字一個字浮上來，PHOTOGRAPHY 跟著出現，然後打開。

desc.en: The words appear just behind the tip of the line as it runs, as if the line were writing them.
desc.zh: 線往右跑的時候，字跟在線頭後面一點一點出現，好像是線把名字寫出來。

desc.en: The words are there with the line. When it is full, the paper parts along it: TUAN goes up, PHOTOGRAPHY down, the photograph between.
desc.zh: 字和線一起出現。線跑滿了，紙就沿著線分開：TUAN 往上、PHOTOGRAPHY 往下，照片在中間出現。

desc.en: When the line is full, the words go and the line runs on to both edges of the screen; the photograph opens out of it like a widening slit.
desc.zh: 線跑滿了，字淡掉，線繼續往兩邊延伸到螢幕邊；照片從這條線裡打開，像一道縫慢慢張大。

desc.en: When the line is full, it empties from the left and runs off to the right, like a timer starting over. The words fade with it, then the paper.
desc.zh: 線跑滿了，接著從左邊開始收、往右邊跑掉，像計時器重新開始。字跟著淡掉，紙再淡掉。

desc.en: As the line fills, the paper thins a little, so the photograph shows faintly behind the logo before it opens.
desc.zh: 線越跑越滿，紙也慢慢變薄一點，打開之前就隱約看得到後面的照片。

desc.en: Arrives as 7. Then the paper parts along the line: the top half with TUAN goes up first, the bottom half with PHOTOGRAPHY follows a beat later.
desc.zh: 出現跟第 7 版一樣。接著紙沿著線分開：上半張帶著 TUAN 先往上走，下半張帶著 PHOTOGRAPHY 慢一拍往下。

desc.en: Arrives as 7. TUAN fades, then PHOTOGRAPHY; the line runs on to both edges of the screen and the photograph opens out of it.
desc.zh: 出現跟第 7 版一樣。TUAN 先淡掉，PHOTOGRAPHY 再淡掉；線延伸到螢幕兩邊，照片從線裡打開。

desc.en: Arrives as 7. TUAN fades, then PHOTOGRAPHY, while the line empties from the left and runs off to the right; then the paper fades.
desc.zh: 出現跟第 7 版一樣。TUAN 先淡掉、PHOTOGRAPHY 再淡掉，同時線從左邊收、往右跑掉；紙再淡掉。

desc.en: Arrives as 7. While the name settles, the paper thins and the photograph shows faintly behind it, then it opens.
desc.zh: 出現跟第 7 版一樣。名字出來之後，紙慢慢變薄，隱約看到後面的照片，然後打開。
